messages:
ivy (sales): Nova Ops asked for a one-page runbook: create ephemeral hosted API keys for their POC, auto-rotate from their CI, plus an emergency revoke. Can we confirm minimal secure steps?

ben (solutions): Minimal flow: 1) POST to /v1/provision/keys to create ephemeral key (one-time client_secret). 2) store client_secret in their vault. 3) run scheduled job: provision new -> smoke test -> swap in vault -> revoke old. Use IP allowlist if desired.

ben (solutions): Example create payload (compact): POST /v1/provision/keys {"customer":"nova","type":"ephemeral","ttl_seconds":86400,"scopes":["generation:invoke"],"ip_allowlist":["198.51.100.0/22"]} -> returns {"key_id","client_secret"} (secret shown once).

rachel (security): Security rules: default TTL 24h for sensitive POCs, 72h allowed with approval. All creations must include audit_tag=poc:nova. Revoke is DELETE /v1/keys/{key_id} (admin token). Do not store secrets in source.

provision-bot: Policy: issuance_limit=10/hr; requires audit_tag=poc:nova; callback_hmac_supported=true.

ivy (sales): Can you give a two-line curl create + revoke pair I can paste to them?

ben (solutions): Create (curl): curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/provision/keys" -H "Authorization: Bearer $PROVISION_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"customer":"nova","type":"ephemeral","ttl_seconds":86400,"ip_allowlist":["198.51.100.0/22"]}' # returns key_id + client_secret

ben (solutions): Revoke (curl, admin): curl -X DELETE "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/<key_id>" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"

nova-ops (customer): We want a webhook when a new key is issued so our pipeline can pick up the key_id and rotate automatically. Is that safe?

rachel (security): Callbacks supported. They contain metadata (key_id, expires_at, scopes) but never client_secret. Callbacks must be HTTPS and verify HMAC header we sign. We'll enable audit retention for the POC.

ivy (sales): Action items: ben -> provision initial ephemeral key and paste final curl with IP ranges; rachel -> security signoff and audit tag; ivy -> deliver runbook + CI snippet to Nova.

rachel (security): Approved: 24h TTL, audit_tag=poc:nova, IP allowlist 198.51.100.0/22, callback HMAC required. :white_check_mark:

ivy (sales): Thanks everyone ":thumbsup:"
